CustomField.description: Whether the device is PROVABLY shown to have gone unused for more than a year before this calibration. § 34 Abs. 1 Satz 4 MessEV is relief from the sentence before it: a device calibrated after expiry normally has its new period backdated to the old period's end (Satz 3), and only a device nachweislich laenger als ein Jahr nicht verwendet gets the Tag der Eichung instead. Nachweislich is a burden of proof, so this must be an explicit claim on the record - never a default. Left false, EichrechtService applies the backdating.
CustomField.label: Stilllegung > 1 Jahr nachgewiesen
